title: What Will Our School Look Like in 2040?
subtitle: Explore imaginative concepts for the school of tomorrow – or describe your own idea and let AI paint the picture.
notice: These are imaginative concepts for the exhibition, not the school's actual plans. Visuals are prepared concept illustrations.
promptSuggestions: Robots helping in the science lab
VR field trip to the Moon
A classroom that adapts to every student

scenarios.title: AI-Powered Classrooms
scenarios.tagline: Lessons that adapt to every learner
scenarios.description: Imagine classrooms where an AI assistant helps the teacher see which concepts each student finds easy or hard, suggesting activities so nobody is left behind.
features: Teacher dashboards that highlight who needs help

scenarios.title: Robot Teaching Assistants
scenarios.description: Friendly robots could help with routine tasks – handing out materials, guiding visitors or running language practice – so teachers have more time for students.
features: Robots that guide visitors around campus
Lab helpers that fetch equipment safely

scenarios.title: Smart Laboratories
scenarios.description: Smart labs might combine real experiments with sensors and simulations, letting students test ideas safely before trying them for real.

scenarios.title: Virtual Reality Education
scenarios.description: With VR headsets, students could walk through ancient cities, explore the human heart or stand on the Moon – all from the classroom.
features: Shared VR lessons for the whole class

scenarios.title: Smart Campus
scenarios.description: Smart lights, digital notice boards and energy sensors could make the campus safer, greener and easier to navigate.
features: Lights that switch off in empty rooms

scenarios.title: Eco-Friendly School
scenarios.description: Solar roofs, rainwater harvesting and rooftop gardens could turn the whole school into a living lesson in sustainability.

scenarios.title: Personalized Learning
scenarios.description: Every student could have a personal learning path that moves at their pace, follows their interests and celebrates their progress.
features: Learning paths that match each student's pace
Progress portfolios to share with parents
